source_row.extraction_instructions: Custom PHP page: /events is one page of blocks opened by <a name=eventNN>, each with h3 title, free-text date line (year sometimes missing: taken from the footer copyright year), location line and free HTML. Past, undated and in-progress programmes are dropped. The annual Congress is not on that page: the newest /congress-YYYY/highlights page gives dates, city and edition, /general-information the venue and /registration the euro fee tables (IN PERSON / VIRTUAL ONLY x EARLY / REGULAR, member / non-member / Bench-to-Bedside).

registry_comment: SIU (urology): events page blocks + annual Congress from /congress-YYYY pages (EUR fee tables)

concerns: Only 2 upcoming events exist: the SIU 2026 Congress (Florence) and the SIU Regional Meeting (Wuhan). The events page also holds a Residents' Hub post (30 April 2026, 'Various'), eGrand Rounds (12 February 2026, past) and the Urotrainer programme (31 Aug-21 Nov, remote, already running, enrolment closed); all three are skipped by the date rules (a programme that started more than a week before today and lasts longer than a week counts as in progress).
Year-less date lines ('August 31-November 21') take their year from the page footer copyright; if the footer is missing the block is skipped.

The Congress is found through /congress-YYYY links on the events page and the 'will take place in <city>, <country>, from <dates>' sentence on /highlights; a wording change there makes the Congress shell disappear (a WARNING is logged), it would not mis-date.

Fees: public EUR prices for the Congress, regular column only (early deadline 15 July has passed; the extractor drops closed early columns using the Congress year). Member categories use World Bank income bands. 'Free with SIU Membership' rows (virtual resident/trainee) carry no price and are skipped; the member rates are printed publicly on the page, nothing is behind a login. Fees are as published and exclude 22 percent Italian VAT; every congress tier label ends with "· excl. 22% VAT".

The Regional Meeting block has no body text, so no description, venue or fees (organiser page not linked). Coverage checklist: fee locations checked for the Congress (registration page, no image table, no external fee link); the Regional Meeting has none on the site.
Request budget: events page + highlights + general-information + registration = 4 requests per scrape. Forced-fallback run gave the same 2 shells.
Status partial only because the source yields 2 events; everything found is verified.

Runner failure 2026-10-22 07:21 UTC (job 119692387004): GET https://www.siu-urology.org/events returned HTTP 500 (empty body), so the listing had 0 cards and the source was recorded 'failed'. Reproduced locally the same day from a home IP: the home page, /events and every /congress-2026 page also return 500 with an empty body, so this is an origin outage on siu-urology.org, not a runner block or a markup change. Fix: when the events page gives no usable response the extractor now calls http_fetch.note_unreachable (same pattern as uroweb.py), so the run is recorded 'unreachable' (WARNING, 3-strike rule) instead of 'failed'. Also added a discovery fallback: if the events page has no /congress-YYYY links the current year is tried. Verified by simulation (no response -> unreachable counter 1; page without congress links -> Congress still found). Live re-check of the 2 shells must wait until the site answers 200 again.
